newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CelTech recovers after loss report knock.
newsitem.headline: CelTech recovers after loss report knock.

text.p: Dropping shortly after announcing continued losses, South African cellular phone systems distributor Celtron Technologies Ltd later recovered.
Dealers said the share was knocked by the group's still disappointing first half results but it had looked like a bargain at lower levels and this had pushed it back up.
Celtech fell to 64 cents from its previous 75 cents close.
But by 0930 GMT it had recovered to 76 cents, adding a cent.
Dealers said trading in the share would likely be subdued for the rest of the day. Volumes traded were 225,100 shares.
"They (CelTech) have announced a three million rand loss and I think that may be having an effect on the share price," one dealer said.

CelTech on Friday reported a 3.53 million rand loss in its attributable earnings for the six months ended March 31 compared to a previous loss of 4.85 million rand, and cautioned that it would not achieve its forecast for the year.
The company reported a first half loss of 6.8 cents compared to a previous loss of 13.2 cents.
